attempted_claim: Stem 2-step nilpotent Lie algebras over Q of dimension 7 with dim[g,g]=dim Z(g)=3 (type V=4, W=3): nine explicit integer triples G1..G9 with Pfaffian forms x1^2+x2^2+x3^2, x1^2-x2^2+x3^2, x1^2-t*x2^2 (t=1,2,3,5,7), x1^2, 0 are pairwise non-isomorphic over Q via Pf-rank/isotropy/square-class (Der dims 19,19,20x5,22,25; H2 11x8,12); Lemma f'(y)=lambda f(Q*y) with lambda=det(P)^-1 makes Pf-rank, isotropy and rank-2 square class t/s in (Q*)^2 isomorphism invariants; hence infinite family g_t (t prime) gives infinitely many Q-types and no finite complete census exists.
claim_type: partial census with infinitude refutation and exact rational certificates
decisive_failure: originality: Bazzoni 2011/2012 substantively covers and implies the candidate's core census and infinitude. Hypotheses match: Bazzoni classifies 2-step dim-7 over any field char!=2 (hence Q) via F0+F1 with cases (6,1),(5,2),(4,3); candidate's V=span e1..e4 (dim 4) + W=span e5..e7 (dim 3) with injective wedge map is exactly Bazzoni case (4,3) length-2. Quantifiers/parameter ranges match: Bazzoni Theorem 1 gives 10+2r+s classes where r=|k*/(k*)^2| and s=#quaternion algebras; over Q both r and s are infinite (squarefree integers/primes; infinite quaternion division algebras), so infinitude and impossibility of finite census are immediate corollaries, identical to candidate Theorem 2. Exact invariants match: Bazzoni Section 6 conic canonical form Y0^2-aY1^2-bZ^2, rank 1 (double line), rank 2 (X^2-aY^2, a in k*/(k*)^2, eq.8 model dy5=y1y4+y2y3, dy6=a y1y3+y2y4, dy7=y1y2), rank 3 smooth (det+Hasse/quaternion, Theorem 2, eq.10 dy7=y1y2-b y3y4) are the same stratification as candidate Pf-rank 0/1/2/3, isotropy (aniso x1^2+x2^2+x3^2 vs iso x1^2-x2^2+x3^2), and square-class t/s in (Q*)^2 for f=x1^2-t x2^2. Explicit overlap: Bazzoni model dx5=x1x2,dx6=x1x3,dx7=x1x4 is dual to candidate G9 ([e1,e2]=e5,[e1,e3]=e6,[e1,e4]=e7); Bazzoni rank-2 Galois-descent family realizes all square classes like candidate G3..G7 (t=1,2,3,5,7 are five of infinitely many). Lemma transformation law f'=lambda f(Q*) is Bazzoni's conic projective equivalence / quadratic-form isometry criterion in different language, and Lauret's Pfaffian projective equivalence. Therefore nine Q-witnesses are nine representatives of Bazzoni's already-parametrized infinite Q-families, and prime-infinitude is the standard square-class infinitude. Candidate's exact Der dims (19,20,22,25) and H1/H2 machine certificates are auxiliary computations not in Bazzoni, but they do not rescue originality of the census/infinitude claim itself. Record's cited arXiv:0805.3380 and math/0703802 were verified live to resolve to unrelated papers (cross-curvature flow; Levy processes), and uwspace handle 10012/133 no longer resolves to Gong, indicating prior audit missed the true nearest prior (Bazzoni).
